title: Seetha in Ashoka garden
introduction: In this chapter Valmiki describes the plight of Seetha in Ashoka garden in detail.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 19th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन्नेव ततः काले राजपुत्री त्वनिन्दिता |
रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं भूषणोत्तमभूषितम्
ततो दृष्ट्वैव वैदेही रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम् |
प्रावेपत वरारोहा प्रवाते कदली यथा
verses.iast:
tasminneva tataḥ kāle rājaputrī tvaninditā |
rūpayauvanasampannaṃ bhūṣaṇottamabhūṣitam
tato dṛṣṭvaiva vaidehī rāvaṇam rākśasādhipam |
prāvepata varārohā pravāte kadalī yathā
verses.translation: Thereafter at that time Seetha a princess without any blame of excellent limbs shook like a plantain tree in wind on seeing Ravana the king of rakshasas endowed with beauty and youth adorned with excellent ornaments.

verses.devanagari:
आच्छाद्योदरमूरुभ्यां बाहुभ्यां च पयोधरौ |
उपविष्टा विशालाक्षी रुदन्ती वरवर्णिनी
verses.iast:
ācchādyodaramūrubhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ ca payodharau |
upaviṣṭā viśālākṣī rudantī varavarṇinī
verses.translation: The wide eyed Seetha with excellent color covering stomach with thighs and breasts with hands sat down crying.

verses.devanagari:
दशग्रीवस्तु वैदेहीम् रक्षितां राक्षसीगणैः |
ददर्श दीनाम् दुःखार्तां नावं सन्नामिवार्णवे
verses.iast:
daśagrīvastu vaidehīm rakṣitāṃ rākśasīgaṇaiḥ |
dadarśa dīnām duḥkhārtāṃ nāvaṃ sannāmivārṇave
verses.translation: Ravana saw Seetha protected by batches of ogres looking miserable being struck with grief like a ship in danger in the sea.

verses.devanagari:
असंवृतायामासीनाम् धरण्याम् संशितव्रताम् |
चिनां प्रपतितां भूमौ शाखामिव वनस्पतेः
verses.iast:
asaṃvṛtāyāmāsīnām dharaṇyām saṃśitavratām |
cināṃ prapatitāṃ bhūmau śākhāmiva vanaspateḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Seetha sitting down on uncovered land, with a firm resolve, like a branch of a tree fallen down on earth being torn from the tree.

glosses.meaning: like a branch of a tree

verses.devanagari:
मलमण्डनचित्राङ्गीम् मण्डनार्हाममण्डिताम् |
मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति न विभाति च
verses.iast:
malamaṇḍanacitrāṇ^gīm maṇḍanārhāmamaṇḍitām |
mṛṇālī paṇ^kadigdheva vibhāti na vibhāti ca
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Seetha with a stange body with dirt as ornament, who although suited to decorate with ornaments was without ornaments. Although She was shining like a lotus stem covered with mud, She was not shining also.

glosses.meaning: (Hanuma saw Seetha) With a strange body with dirt as an ornament

verses.devanagari:
समीपम् राजसिम्हस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः |
सङ्कल्पहयसम्युक्तैर्यान्तीमिव मनोरथैः
verses.iast:
samīpam rājasimhasya rāmasya viditātmanaḥ |
saṇ^kalpahayasamyuktairyāntīmiva manorathaiḥ
verses.translation: Seetha was as though going near to Rama a lion among kings with a famous personality with desires as chariot tied with thoughts as horses.

verses.devanagari:
शुष्यन्तीम् रुदतीमेकां ध्यानशोकपरायणाम् |
दुःखस्यान्तमपश्यन्तीं रामां राममनुव्रताम्
verses.iast:
śuṣyantīm rudatīmekāṃ dhyānaśokaparāyaṇām |
duḥkhasyāntamapaśyantīṃ rāmāṃ rāmamanuvratām
verses.translation: Seetha a pleasant one, was emaciated, was crying, being alone having surrendered to Her thoughts and sorrow not seeing the end of grief, following the will of Rama.

glosses.meaning: having surrendered to Her thoughts and sorrow

verses.devanagari:
चेष्टमानां तथाविष्टां पन्नगेन्द्रवधूमिव |
धूप्यमानाम् ग्रहेणेव रोहिणीं धूमकेतुना
verses.iast:
ceṣṭamānāṃ tathāviṣṭāṃ pannagendravadhūmiva |
dhūpyamānām graheṇeva rohiṇīṃ dhūmaketunā
verses.translation: And also Seetha was like a great she-serpant writhing under the spell of an incantation. She was like Rohini being fumigated by a smoke colored planet called Ketu.

glosses.meaning: under the spell of an incantation
by a smoke colored planet called Ketu.

verses.devanagari:
वृत्तशीलकुले जातामाचारवति धार्मिके |
पुनः संस्कारमापन्नां जातामिव च दुष्कुले
verses.iast:
vṛttaśīlakule jātāmācāravati dhārmike |
punaḥ saṃskāramāpannāṃ jātāmiva ca duṣkule
verses.translation: Being born in a virtuous traditional family with good conduct and character and getting married, Seetha appeared as if She was born in a bad family.

glosses.meaning: family with good conduct and character

verses.devanagari:
अभूतेनापवादेन कीर्तीम् निपतितामिव |
अम्नायानामयोगेन विद्यां प्रशिथिलामिव
verses.iast:
abhūtenāpavādena kīrtīm nipatitāmiva |
amnāyānāmayogena vidyāṃ praśithilāmiva
verses.translation: Seetha was like fame fallen down due to false blame. She was like education ruined due to lack of learning by heart.

verses.devanagari:
सन्नामिव महाकीर्तिं श्रद्धामिव विमानिताम् |
प्रज्ञामिव परिक्षीणामाशां प्रतिहतामिव
verses.iast:
sannāmiva mahākīrtiṃ śraddhāmiva vimānitām |
prajJṇāmiva parikṣīṇāmāśāṃ pratihatāmiva
verses.translation: Seetha was like deteriorated great fame,like insulted faith,like an understanding grown feeble, like dulled hope.

verses.devanagari:
आयतीमिव विध्वस्तामाज्ञां प्रतिहतामिव |
दीप्तामिव दिशं काले पूजामपहृतामिव
verses.iast:
āyatīmiva vidhvastāmājJṇāṃ pratihatāmiva |
dīptāmiva diśaṃ kāle pūjāmapahṛtāmiva
verses.translation: Seetha was like an expectation destroyed, like an order flouted; like a blazing quarter during a period of destruction, like a worship stolen.

verses.devanagari:
पद्मिनीमिव विध्वस्तां हतशूरां चमूमिव |
प्रभामिव तमोध्वस्तामुपक्षीणामिवापगाम्
verses.iast:
padminīmiva vidhvastāṃ hataśūrāṃ camūmiva |
prabhāmiva tamodhvastāmupakṣīṇāmivāpagām
verses.translation: Seetha was like a lotus destroyed, like an army with killed warriors, like light destroyed by darkness, like vanished river.

verses.devanagari:
वेदीमिव परामृष्टां शान्तामग्निशिखामिव |
पौर्णमासीमिव निशां राहुग्रस्तेन्दुमण्डलाम्
verses.iast:
vedīmiva parāmṛṣṭāṃ śāntāmagniśikhāmiva |
paurṇamāsīmiva niśāṃ rāhugrastendumaṇḍalām
verses.translation: Seetha was like an altar desecrated, like a tongue of fire gone out, like a full moon night with moon devoured by Rahu.

verses.devanagari:
उत्कृष्टपर्णकमलां वित्रासितविहङ्गमाम् |
हस्तिहस्तपरामृष्टमाकुलां पद्मिनीमिव
verses.iast:
utkṛṣṭaparṇakamalāṃ vitrāsitavihaṇ^gamām |
hastihastaparāmṛṣṭamākulāṃ padminīmiva
verses.translation: Seetha was like a lotus pond agitated with torned out leaves and lotuses, being roughly traeated by the trunk of an elephant.

glosses.meaning: with torned out leaves and lotuses
(being) roughly treated by the trunk of an elephant.

verses.devanagari:
पतिशोकातुरां शुष्कां नदीं विस्रावितामिव |
परया मृजया हीनाम् कृष्णपक्षनिशामिव
verses.iast:
patiśokāturāṃ śuṣkāṃ nadīṃ visrāvitāmiva |
parayā mṛjayā hīnām kṛṣṇapakśaniśāmiva
verses.translation: Grieved for husband, Seetha was like a river which has dried uo with water caused to flow out lacking best washing, was like a new moon night.

verses.devanagari:
सुकुमारीम् सुजाताङ्गीं रत्न गर्भगृहोचिताम् |
तप्यमानामिवोष्णेन मृणालीमचिरोद्धृताम्
verses.iast:
sukumārīm sujātāṇ^gīṃ ratna garbhagṛhocitām |
tapyamānāmivoṣṇena mṛṇālīmaciroddhṛtām
verses.translation: Seetha was a delicate one with well built limbs, accustomed to houses full of diamonds, being tormented by heat, like a lotus fibre uprooted short time back.

glosses.meaning: accustomed to houses full of diamonds

verses.devanagari:
गृहीतामाळितां स्तम्भे यूथपेन विनाकृताम् |
निःश्वसन्तीं सुदुःखार्तां गजराजवधूमिव
verses.iast:
gṛhītāmāLitāṃ stambhe yūthapena vinākṛtām |
niḥśvasantīṃ suduḥkhārtāṃ gajarājavadhūmiva
verses.translation: Seetha was like a she-elephant captured and tied to a pillar, made to be without the leader of herd, sighing, very much tormented by grief.

glosses.meaning: (to be) without the leader of herd

verses.devanagari:
एकया दीर्घया वेण्या शोभमानामयत्नतः |
नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव
verses.iast:
ekayā dīrghayā veṇyā śobhamānāmayatnataḥ |
nīlayā nīradāpāye vanarājyā mahīmiva
verses.translation: With a long single plait, shining without effort, Seetha was like the earth with dark groups of trees at the end of rainy season.

glosses.meaning: at the end of rainy season.

verses.devanagari:
उपवासेन शोकेन ध्यानेन च भयेन च |
परिक्षीणां कृशां दीनामल्पाहारां तपोधनाम्
verses.iast:
upavāsena śokena dhyānena ca bhayena ca |
parikṣīṇāṃ kṛśāṃ dīnāmalpāhārāṃ tapodhanām
verses.translation: Wasted, emaciated due to fasting, due to sorrow, due to thought and due to fear, Seetha was with limited food and with austerity as wealth.

verses.devanagari:
आयाचमानाम् दुःखार्तां प्राञ्जलिं देवतामिव |
भावेन रघुमुख्यस्य दशग्रीवपराभवम्
verses.iast:
āyācamānām duḥkhārtāṃ prāJṇjaliṃ devatāmiva |
bhāvena raghumukhyasya daśagrīvaparābhavam
verses.translation: Seetha was like a celestial being, tormented by grief and by thought with joined palms, desiring the defeat of Ravana at the hands of Sri Rama

verses.devanagari:
समीक्षमाणां रुदतीमनिन्दितां |
सुपक्ष्मताम्रायतशुक्ललोचनाम् |
अनुव्रतां राममतीव मैथिलीं |
प्रलोभयामास वधाय रावणः
verses.iast:
samīkṣamāṇāṃ rudatīmaninditāṃ |
supakṣmatāmrāyataśuklalocanām |
anuvratāṃ rāmamatīva maithilīṃ |
pralobhayāmāsa vadhāya rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Ravana was trying to allure and threatening death to Seetha who was looking at every direction, crying, without blame, with good eye lids and reddish and white eyes, with an excessive vow to follow Sri Rama.

glosses.meaning: who was looking at every direction
with good eye lids and reddish and white eyes
with an excessive vow to follow
